sheets.title: 1200 AMP SERVICE AT SIMS METAL — ONE LINE DIAGRAM
sheets.reading_notes: Formal BFA-sealed one-line diagram for new 1200A electrical service. Shows: utility service entry via Dominion Energy meter base → CT cabinet → 1200A 277/480V MCB (SE rated, ground fault, NEMA 3R, 65 KAIC) → feeds via 4-3" conduits w/4-350MCM (3-phase/4-wire). Downstream: 1200A 480V 3P/3W MCB NEMA 1 panel 65 KAIC with mostly 'FUTURE' circuits populated. Two active circuits: 40A 3-P CB → 15kVA 480-240V scale house transformer; 70A 3-P CB → 45kVA 480-277/480V lighting transformer. Additional distribution run: 4-3" conduits w/3-350MCM & 1/0 ground (3-phase/4-wire). Two 6" empty conduits stubbed at DVP for future use. Grounding per NEC (typical). Drawing date 12/04/2024.

sheets.title: New 1200A Service at Sims Metals — Design Sketch
sheets.reading_notes: Informal design sketch / design-development one-line, likely an earlier revision or a mark-up shared by email. No BFA title block or PE seal. System topology is essentially identical to SKE-1 with minor differences: (1) downstream distribution feeder shown as 3-phase/3-wire (vs 4-wire on SKE-1); (2) main MCB not annotated with 65 KAIC; (3) panel listed as 'MBO' vs 'MCB' on SKE-1 — likely a drafting variant. Color-coded (red = power distribution, blue = grounding/neutral) for clarity. Content is otherwise consistent with SKE-1 and corroborates all major system facts.
